children: Overview
UK hostel operator's H1 revenue fell 11% yr/yr amid challenging trading conditions
Adjusted EBITDA dropped sharply, and company posted a net loss after tax
Company attributed results to lower occupancy and higher operating costs
Outlook
Company says forward bookings as of 22 Sep 2026 are down 21% year-on-year to £3.7 mln
Safestay expects continued cost pressures from VAT changes in Europe and higher UK business rates
Company is considering further disposals, sale and leasebacks, and growth via franchising and leaseholds
Result Drivers
LOWER OCCUPANCY - Co said occupancy fell to 60.8% from 68.2%, contributing to revenue decline
HIGHER OPERATING COSTS - Co cited increased National Living Wage and National Insurance contributions in the UK and higher operating expenses as pressuring margins
GROUP BOOKINGS DECLINE - Co said group bookings fell due to softer inbound tourism and reduced focus on group sales after property disposal announcements
